title: Amazing sailing and wine day
text:
My parents and I had a great time at this wine tasting aboard the catamaran. The captain and the sailor were very attentive. The selection of local wines and tapas, pairings were top notch. Celina, the sommelier did an excellent job, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

Sailing along the coast of Barcelona at sunset, drinking wine with my family, was peaceful and unforgettable, priceless!

I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting Barcelona.
author: openbcn

title: Unforgettable sunset wine tasting in Barcelona!!
text:
My  friends and I had the most incredible experience on this wine-tasting onto the catamaran. We were welcome with warm and smiles and exceptional hospitality. The crew was incredibly kind and attentive. The wine selection and food, special the ham☺️ was fantastic. Celina explained everything with a lot of passion and dedication.
Sailing along the coast of Barcelona during sunset, with good wine and great company, has been an incredible and absolutely recommendable experience 🤎
author: 222marissap
